title: NBA Turnovers props (player_turnovers) can never be graded from a box score: no STAT_KEYS entry, always void
device: code review + scratch pipeline (no UI repro possible: demo DB has no props)
steps: statValue('player_turnovers', {blocks:2,steals:1,turnovers:3,points:20}) falls through to `STAT_KEYS[stat] ?? []` and returns undefined
refreshPlayerLogs (tick.ts) and ingestPropResults (grade.ts) both drop rows where statValue is undefined, so no player_logs row exists
settleEdges/gradePicks then wait 24h and settle props={} -> gradeBet returns 'void'
expected: PROP_MARKETS.nba requests player_turnovers; an edge/pick on it is settled win/loss/push from the box score
actual: player_turnovers is requested, priced, can be graded A/B and logged to edges_log/picks, but always ends 'void' (0 units) because the stat key is unmapped. Voids hide real results and skew the public track record.
evidence: worker/src/simulate.ts lines ~: STAT_KEYS has only player_points/rebounds/assists/threes (+ non-NBA keys); PRA is special-cased in statValue. Pipeline script /tmp/pnba/pipe.ts shows these three markets reach grading (consensus-only).
suspected_area: STAT_KEYS missing entries (suggest ['blocks','blk'], ['steals','stl'], ['turnovers','tov','to']); also PROP_BETA has no entry for them (defaults to 0.7)
